name: Porphyritic-Antiphon
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an orbital debris ring.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
the automated beacon of unknown purpose was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Whoever controls nitrogen controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
